questions.question: How many project-native facts can Patchline extract from existing migration, source, test, operational, and generated-evidence surfaces in repositories not designed for Patchline?
questions.real_repo_requirement: Run on the four pinned public slices and report non-zero facts for each slice.

questions.question: Does Patchline rank data-change risks with stable, evidence-backed identifiers rather than path-only or grep-only matches?
questions.real_repo_requirement: Run on the four pinned public slices and report ranked risks with stable IDs for each slice.

questions.question: How often are ranked risks linked to concrete repository facts, provenance slices, and owner-relevant evidence?
questions.real_repo_requirement: Run on the four pinned public slices and report non-zero evidence links for each slice.

questions.question: Can generated interventions remain deterministic, bounded, fact-grounded, and checkable before maintainers review them?
questions.real_repo_requirement: Run deterministic no-LLM proposals on the four pinned public slices and report generated files plus check outcomes.

questions.question: Can Patchline re-analyze generated interventions and report before/after deltas instead of stopping at one-shot findings?
questions.real_repo_requirement: Run compare on the four pinned public slices and report compare hashes and intervention-loop evidence.
